text: The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
No waaaay~...\nDo we really have to push forward while beating\nthese things?
What a pain in the butt!\nBeating them one by one is such a pain in the\nbutt...
Monsters of the same kind as those around the\nstone monument are also seen here. The Fragrant\nGravels may have an effect on them too...
I see...If we use them, we'll be able to eliminate\nthe monsters more efficiently, right...?
Okay. Let's collect them so that we can get to\nNov Diela faster.
OK! Then let's go to collect those Fragrant Gravel\nthingies quickly...
But wait, if we're going to the Witch's Woods,\nthat means w-w-w-we're going to pass through\nt-t-t-that stone monument, aren't we?!
There's a ghost over there, right...?
No, no, no...\nIf that's the case, I'll just wait here.
What? The ghost has left the stone monument and\nis heading for the Dark Realm? So it's okay now?!\nReallyyy?
Well, alright then. If the ghost is still there,\nI'll send you flying with this hammer!\nLet's go now!
Aye, if the ghost is there, I'll fight too, so no\nneed to worry! Let's go, let's go!
